s: Seder habdala bemotzae yom tob ubo d' seipim: bemotzae yom tob, ben bemotzae yom tob lechol uben bemotzae yom tob lechullo shel moed — tzarik lomar habdala bebirkat "chonen haddaat", dehaynu "atta chonantanu" kemo bemotzae shabbat. Vetzarik gam ken lehabdil al hakkos kemo bemotzae shabbat. Ella sheen tzarik lebarek lo al hanner velo al habbesamim, lepi sheen mebarekin al hanner ella bemotzae shabbat ubemotzae yom hakkippurim, shenneesar or kol hayyom veakshav chozer lehettero, kemo shennitbaer besiman rch"tz, abal beyom tob lo neesar haor leolam letzorek yom tob. Veal habbesamim gam ken en tzarik lebarek ella bemotzae shabbat, kede lehashib et hannepesh shekkoebet al hanneshama yetera shehayeta bo beshabbat vehaleka mimmennu bemotzae shabbat, abal beyom tob en laadam neshama yetera kelal:

Behabdala shebbemotzae yom tob shehu chal bechol gam ken tzarik lomar: "ben yom hashshebii lesheshet yeme hammaaseh", kemo shennitbaer besiman rtz"v. Veap sheakshav hu emtza hashshabua — en bekak kelum, lepi shesseder habdalot hakketubot battora hu moneh: "ben qodesh lechol", "ben or lechoshek", "ben yisrael laammim" ku':

Mi shennimsheka seudato bemotzae yom tob haacharon shel pesach ad leachar tzet hakkokabim — muttar leekol chametz basseuda ap sheadayin lo hitpallel arbit velo hibdil kelal, lepi sheissur chametz eno taluy behabdala kelal, dekevan shechasheka hu layla lekol dabar, ukebar haleka mimmennu qedushshat yom tob. Umah sheasur baasiyyat melaka qodem hahabdala eno mechamat qedushshat yom tob, ella shehachakamim asaruhu mittaam shennitbaer besiman rtz"t. (Veap lehosip mechol al haqqodesh en tzarik ki im leinyan shebitat yom tob mimmelaka, shezzeh nilmad mimmah shekkatub: "tishbetu shabbattekem", kemo shennitbaer besiman rs"a). Abal leinyan shear debarim hatteluyim biqdushshat hayyom, kegon mitzvat "miqra qodesh" ayyen siman tqk"t — en tzarik lehosip mechol al haqqodesh. Vekol shekken leinyan akilat chametz, sheeno taluy kelal biqdushshat hayyom, shehare ap bechullo shel moed asur leekol chametz:

Yom tob shechal beereb shabbat — en mabdilin, shehare qedushshat shabbat chamura miqqedushshat yom tob. Abal yom tob shechal bemotzae shabbat — tzarik lehabdil al hakkos, kemo shennitbaer besiman ta"g, vegam tzarik lehabdil battepilla, sheyyomar "vattodienu ku'" qodem "vattitten lanu":
